limitations: Only isolated C32 expansion GPU spans; no contraction, complete graph, bridge or game FPS.
Seven fixed generated-model inputs; known frozen RX9070XT/26.9.1 only. No arbitrary-input preserving claim.
Five warmups per route follow one preflight execution. All three pairs and all samples retained. Order B/C,C/B,B/C is unbalanced; clock/thermal causes are unmeasured.
Two timestamps per route include compute barriers; CPU submission/fence wait, uploads and explicit readback are outside spans.
Passing timing buffers were not saved;28 reported hashes match independently reopened actual49 canonical E4 outputs.
Timing reports record validation layers disabled; bounded and actual manifests omit enabled-layer status. Zero reported errors does not establish enabled-layer coverage.
Resource counts and static ISA counts came from separate pipeline capture; they are not runtime instruction counts or ordinary timing.
Isolated median sums are estimates, not full inference timing.
Target row-count operator checks and fixed generated-model inputs do not establish complete target-frame quality or independently evolved neural histories.
